lines.speaker: Grandpa Gingko
lines.text: My spectacles! Now I can see what a hero you are. This Star Shard is yours.

lines.speaker: Grandpa Gingko
lines.text: A rascally pterosaur nicked my spectacles! It nests across the Tar Crater, up on the heights. Bring them back and my brightest Star Shard is yours.
